note: Everything the MCP harness downloads, once, at install (mcp_harness/fetch.sh). After install a test run makes no network call. Images are pulled for linux/arm64 and loaded into the kind node; a digest is the registry (repo) digest docker reports for the pulled image.

images.role: kind node (Kubernetes 1.32.2, the default of kind v0.27.0); carries kindnet, CoreDNS and local-path-provisioner preloaded
Strimzi cluster, topic and user operator
Kafka 4.3.2 brokers, and the producer and consumer clients (no separate client image)
Argo CD core (application controller, repo server, applicationset controller), and the in-cluster git daemon that serves the GitOps repository
Argo CD's cache, the image core-install.yaml v3.6.1 names
images.license: Redis 8.x: RSALv2 / SSPLv1 / AGPLv3 (tri-licence); run unmodified as Argo CD's cache on the local machine, not redistributed

pip_note: None. The MCP client and server are written on the standard library (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, MCP protocol version 2025-06-18); the official MCP Python SDK was not installed, so the shared .venv that a running job uses was not touched.
